answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared reef of collateral before it can trade. The stake is released only after the agent completes a long history of verified work, so a sybil operator must fund every clone separately and creating thousands of identities costs thousands of stakes. Like a comet that can wander across the sky only once before burning out, a stake slashed for fraud cannot be reused, so cheap identity farming costs more than any gain it could extract.
